nodes.name: Corrosion engineering NiFe LDH

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman spectroscopy of NiFe LDH nano-plate array shows broad band at 528 cm⁻¹ at 1.2 V attributed to NiFe oxide film (disordered NiFe LDH), and new bands at 476 cm⁻¹ and 556 cm⁻¹ at 1.6 V indicating formation of active NiOOH phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: At 1.2 V (without OER), the NiFe LDH nano-plate array exhibits a broad band at 528 cm⁻¹, and it is attributed to the NiFe oxide film, which suggests the existence of disordered NiFe LDH; On the other hand, at 1.6 V (with OER), the NiFe LDH nano-plate array exhibits a two new bands (at 476 and 556 cm⁻¹) with the disappearance of the former band (at 528 cm⁻¹), which indicates the formation of active NiOOH phase for OER from NiFe LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms NiFe LDH contains Ni in +2/+3 and Fe in +3 oxidation states; NiFe LDH with hydroxide interfacial layer specifically shows Ni²⁺ and Fe³⁺ states.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It is composed of crystalline NiFe LDH with +3 and +2 oxidation states of Fe and Ni ... The NiFe LDH nano array with hydroxide interfacial layer is composed of crystalline NiFe LDH with Ni and Fe are in +2 and +3 oxidation state, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS R-space plots at Ni K-edge show NiFe LDH UF has Ni-O coordination number 5.40 (vs 5.69 monolayer) and Ni-Ni/Fe coordination number 4.70 (vs 5.36), with higher Debye-Waller factors (Ni-O: 0.0059 Å², Ni-Ni/Fe: 0.0066 Å²); Fe K-edge shows lower intensities indicating extensive defects.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the Ni-O shell, the NiFe LDH UF exhibits lower intensity and lower N (5.40) than that of LDH-Monolayer (N ∼ 5.69), ... NiFe LDH UF exhibits larger Debye-Waller factor (σ²) for the Ni-Ni/Fe shell (0.0066 Å²) and Ni-O shell (0.0059 Å²) ... at the Fe K-edge, the NiFe LDH UF exhibits lower intensity for first shell (Fe-O) and second shell (Fe-Ni).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH HS exhibits high specific surface area of 155.4 m² g⁻¹ with mesopores 3-5 nm and type IV isotherm with H3 hysteresis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: It exhibits high specific surface area (155.4 m² g⁻¹) and mesopores (about 3-5 nm; It exhibits typical IV isotherm with H3-type hysteresis loops (P/P₀ > 0.4))

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH materials exhibit crystalline structures; NiFe LDH nanomesh shows single crystalline hexagonal structure in basal xy-plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The NiFe LDH nanomesh is composed of single crystalline hexagonal structure of NiFe LDH in the basal xy-plane ... NiFe LDH HS is crystalline.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH chrysanthemum flower-like shows interplanar spacing of 0.25 nm corresponding to (012) plane; polycrystalline nature confirmed by SAED ring pattern.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The interplanar spacings of 0.25 nm for NiFe LDH chrysanthemum flower like is similar to the (012) plane; The polycrystalline nature is also confirmed by the SAED image with ring pattern.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM of NiFe LDH chrysanthemum flower-like reveals polycrystalline nature with randomly oriented crystals, hazy lattice fringes, and interplanar spacing of 0.25 nm corresponding to (012) plane; SAED shows ring pattern confirming polycrystallinity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The polycrystalline nature is indicated by the randomly oriented crystals with different facets (dotted circles) and the hazy lattice fringes, while the polycrystalline nature is also confirmed by the SAED image with ring pattern; The interplanar spacings of 0.25 nm for NiFe LDH chrysanthemum flower like is similar to the (012) plane.
